data.name: Nabeelat
data.gender_notes: Nabeelat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nourisher of the Faith. Derived from the word 'naba' which means 'to give news', 'to nourish', 'to feed'. The 'at' suffix is used to denote femininity in Arabic baby names. The name Nabeelat carries the meaning “Nourisher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nabeelat usually hope their child will grow to embody nourisher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is nourished and nurtured by the faith and in turn nurtures those around her.
data.etymology: Nabeelat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nourisher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabeelat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نبيلات
in_arabic.meaning: ذات النبل و الكرم و العقل
in_arabic.long_meaning: نبيلات هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر النبيل، و يعني المرأة ذات النبل و الكرم و العقل، و يوحي بالشرف و المروءة و الحكمة. و في القرآن الكريم، يرتبط النبل بالعقل و الفهم، مما يجعل هذا الاسم ذا قيمة روحية و أخلاقية عالية في التقاليد الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نبیلات
in_urdu.long_meaning: نبیلات ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نوبل، بہیچ، اور عقلمند خاتون۔ یہ نام شرافت، مروت، اور دانائی کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء کی مسلم روایات میں، یہ نام اپنی روحانی اور اخلاقی اہمیت کے لئے جانا جاتا ہے، اور اکثر ان خوبصورت معانی کی بناء پر منتخب کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नबीलत
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च कुल की, सुशीला, बुद्धिमती महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: नबीलत एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो उच्च कुल की, सुशीला, और बुद्धिमती महिला को दर्शाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर अपनी सुंदरता और अर्थ की वजह से चुना जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी गरिमा और पवित्रता के लिए जाना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نبیلات
in_pashto.meaning: نبیل سړی، ښه پوهه، او منښت لرونکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: نبیلات د ښځینه اسم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یی د نبیل سړی، ښه پوهه، او منښت لرونکې ده. په پښتنو او افغانانو کی، دا نوم د شرافت او ښه ځانګړتیاوو سره تړلی دی، او اکثره د خپلو ښایسته معانیو په اساس غوره کیږي.

in_english.name: Nabeelat
in_english.long_meaning: Nabeelat is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from Arabic roots, signifying a noble, intelligent, and virtuous woman. Etymologically linked to the concept of nobility and intellect, this name holds spiritual and moral significance in Islamic tradition. Historically, it reflects the values of dignity, wisdom, and good character. In modern Muslim cultures, Nabeelat is chosen for its positive connotations and aspirational qualities.

pronunciation.pashto: د نبیلات تلفظ د ن-ب-ی-لا-ت په ډول دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Nabeelat signifies the nurturer and sustainer of not only physical but also spiritual needs. It is a powerful name that embodies the essence of motherhood, compassion, and care; values deeply ingrained in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Nabeelat suggests one who is committed to spreading the teachings of Islam and nourishing the faith of others. It signifies a firm belief in the sustenance and guidance of Allah and reminds us of our responsibility to nourish not just ourselves but also those around us through acts of kindness, help, and support.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Nourisher" symbolizes Nourisher of the Faith. Derived from the word 'naba' which means 'to give news', 'to nourish', 'to feed'. The 'at' suffix is used to denote femininity in Arabic baby names.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nabeelat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of nourisher.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Nabeelat bint Abdullah ibn Masud is mentioned in Ibn Sa'd's Kitab Al-Tabaqat Al-Kabir as a wife of Abdullah ibn Masud.
historical_references.context: Ibn Sa'd's Kitab Al-Tabaqat Al-Kabir is a historical reference book that documents the lives and deeds of early Muslims.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nabeelat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Nabeelat in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Nabeelat, which means "Nourisher". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
